title: Build your own decision model
summary: This article explores how to design and implement custom decision models in software, covering patterns and approaches for building maintainable rule-based systems. The author shares practical techniques for representing complex decision logic in code, making it easier to modify and reason about business rules.
problem_solved: Provides a structured approach to building maintainable, testable decision logic that avoids spaghetti if-else code in complex applications.
why_valuable: Decision models are ubiquitous in software (auth, business rules, game logic), and this article offers a systematic way to implement them cleanly.
